reviews.reproduction_unicode_transform_source: const fs=require('node:fs'),assert=require('node:assert/strict'),crypto=require('node:crypto'),{parse}=require('/parser/lib/index.js');const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/paths.json'));function normalize(node,tagged=false){if(Array.isArray(node))return node.map(v=>normalize(v,tagged));if(node&&typeof node==='object'){tagged=tagged||node.type==='TaggedTemplateExpression';const result={};for(const [key,value]of Object.entries(node)){if(['start','end','loc','extra','comments','leadingComments','innerComments','trailingComments'].includes(key))continue;if(node.type==='TemplateElement'&&key==='value'&&!tagged)result[key]={cooked:value.cooked};else result[key]=normalize(value,tagged)}return result}return node}const proof=[];for(const name of files){const source=fs.readFileSync('/original/'+name,'utf8'),reviewed=source.replace(/[\u200c\u200d]/g,c=>'\\u'+c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).padStart(4,'0'));const options={sourceType:'unambiguous',plugins:['typescript','regexpUnicodeSets']};assert.deepEqual(normalize(parse(source,options)),normalize(parse(reviewed,options)),name);fs.writeFileSync('/reviewed/'+name,reviewed);proof.push({path:name,replacements:[...source.matchAll(/[\u200c\u200d]/g)].length,original_sha256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(source).digest('hex'),reviewed_sha256:crypto.createHash('sha256').update(reviewed).digest('hex'),equivalence:'Parsed full-file ASTs retain all executable structure, literal values, cooked untagged templates and raw tagged-template values; comments/locations/raw spelling only excluded.'})}fs.writeFileSync('/reviewed/unicode-remediation-proof.json',JSON.stringify(proof,null,2)+'\n');console.log('PASS full-file AST/value equivalence for '+proof.length+' explicit locale/emoji-test Unicode escape changes; no candidate module executed.');
